overview_description.description: Cherry Network is a forward-thinking Decentralized Autonomous Organization that is building a layer-one blockchain network designed for data processing. Bringing decentralized storage solutions with built-in adaptability to Web3, Cherry offers a wide range of ways for developers to connect with Cherry Network, including a production-ready toolkit that allows them to easily construct dApps.

about_short_description.short_description: Cherry is a blockchain network designed specifically for media activities, with the goal of empowering artists to express themselves.

product.name: Cherry Network
product.description: A community-governed Layer 1 blockchain for decentralized applications, with native support for distributed file storage, smart contracts, media operations, and interoperability with other blockchains.

product.name: Cherry Storage
product.description: A peer-to-peer decentralized file storage module for storing, indexing, and distributing large volumes of data across network storage providers, using IPFS-based infrastructure.

product.name: Cherry Virtual Machine
product.description: A smart contract execution platform for building and running decentralized applications with native access to Cherry’s storage and blockchain capabilities.

product.name: Cherry Interoperability Channels
product.description: Connectivity mechanisms that allow applications and smart contracts to interact with Cherry Network and external blockchains, including Ethereum, Binance Smart Chain, and Tron.

product.name: Cherry Token (CHER)
product.description: The native token of the Cherry ecosystem, used for blockchain fees, decentralized storage and indexing, staking, validator delegation, and community-governed treasury activity.
